newsitem.title: UK: UK shares close lower after volatile budget week.
newsitem.headline: UK shares close lower after volatile budget week.

text.p: Britain's FTSE 100 index of blue-chip stocks ended a three-day winning streak on Friday, as the prospect of an interest rate rise next week helped drag the market lower after initially scoring a record high.
Ending a budget week of extreme market volatility, the FTSE 100 closed 18.9 points lower at 4,812.8, after initially hitting a record 4,879.0. Decliners were in a seven-to-two majority.

Dealers and fund managers said the market was likely to continue cautious in the face of an expected rise in British interest rates next week, as the newly-independent Bank of England battles to prevent the economy overheating.
